value.title: Speed up your captioning API image rebuild
value.context: This week, you merged a PR adding a Dockerfile to your VisionAid repo. Now, your task is to improve that Dockerfile so small code changes don’t reinstall PyTorch every time, the image size shrinks below 1 GB, and the API doesn’t run as root. Get it ready before Priya reviews it.
